name: web-travel-landing-faq-and-dark-app-download-footer
title: Travel Landing FAQ, Dark Download Band and Footer
whatItIs: The lower part of a travel landing page: a beach photo beside accordion FAQ rows, a black band with 'All Your Travel Plans One Smart App' and a hand holding a dark app screen, and a white footer with links and email signup.
whatItMeans: A dark band between light sections creates a strong closing moment, and the hand-held phone makes the download CTA tangible.
techniques: Dark full-width band as the final CTA
Hand-held phone breaking into the band
Lavender FAQ accordions with plus toggles
Footer with newsletter card and store buttons

vocabulary.definition: A contrasting full-width section carrying the final call to action.
A list of rows that expand to reveal answers.
A boxed email signup in a footer.
